changed.title: One-a-side promise: two row ORs merged at a column meeting one row and missing the other force another reader, fan-in-two AND/OR circuits
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool)
    (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (u v : Fin n) (c : Fin m)
    (i j : Fin C.gates.length) (p q : ℕ),
  let g := PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C
  let wire := fun idx : Fin C.gates.length => n + m + idx.val
  let isOr := fun (z : Fin C.gates.length) (a b : ℕ) =>
    (g z.val).op = .or ∧ ((g z.val).inputs = [a, b] ∨ (g z.val).inputs = [b, a])
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C →
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C →
  u ≠ v → i ≠ j → isOr i u.val p → isOr j v.val q →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.readsIn C (Finset.range C.gates.length) u.val = 1 →
  C.output ∉ [u.val, wire i] → G u c = true → G v c = false →
  (C.wires (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach v c)).getD (wire i) false = false ∧
    ∀ t : Fin C.gates.length, isOr t (wire i) (wire j) →
      ∃ h : Fin C.gates.length, h ≠ t ∧ wire i ∈ (g h.val).inputs
changed.unlocks: one step of the count of names against literals on the one-a-side promise, where two row gates merge; it rests on the checked domination row and moves no bound by itself
changed.context: On paper. Compare (u,c) with (v,c), where c meets u and misses v. Except for u, wire values stay ordered until I, since I alone reads u. If I were on at (v,c), the order would continue to the output, a contradiction. If OR T of I,J alone read I, every path from u to the output would pass T. T is on throughout row v via J. Domination gives row containment, contradicted by c. Thus a different gate reads I.

changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 6 bipartite graph with mask 272380 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 11 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 6) => (272380 : ℕ).testBit (6 * u.val + v.val)) 11
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 6 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 12 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out, equal gates merged and unread gates dropped); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 11; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 9 (on paper), a gap of 3. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 9 right, gate j writes wire 10 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 24 inputs with one vertex on each side.

changed.title: The two-lit function of the graph H on 6 points with mask 270715563 on shared wires has an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 9 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 9 ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 6, C.eval (List.ofFn fun k : Fin 6 => decide (k = i ∨ k = j)) = (270715563 : ℕ).testBit (6 * min i.val j.val + max i.val j.val)
changed.unlocks: the exact size of the two-lit-points function of this graph on six shared wires; the family shows where a NOT gate pays with no equal lines
changed.sketch: We hold a circuit of 10 gates, a weak hand form (best over a few point orders and the complement plus a NOT, equal gates merged): OR(0,1), OR(2,6), NOT(7), AND(5,8), OR(3,7), AND(4,10), AND(2,6), OR(9,11), OR(12,13), NOT(14) (inputs 0-5 are the points, gate k is wire 6 + k, output last). We hold no circuit of 9 gates; this is a search. No complete search of ours has run at six points.
